北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好 24℃，风力适中，湿度偏低，记得多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Beijing at 24°C, moderate wind, low humidity. Remember to stay hydrated!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波晴朗 23℃，体感 22℃。北风 5级，风力不小，多穿一点哦。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Ningbo at 23°C, feels like 22°C. North wind force 5, quite windy, so dress a bit warmer.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海 24℃ 阳光明媚，体感舒适。南风轻拂，是个好天气！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Shanghai at 24°C, feels comfortable. A gentle south breeze, what lovely weather!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云 27℃，风力 4级，湿度 52%。体感微热，注意防晒哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Guangzhou at 27°C, wind force 4, 52% humidity. It feels a bit warm, remember sun protection.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云 26℃，北风 4级，湿度 61%。微风习习，体感宜人。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Shenzhen at 26°C, north wind force 4, 61% humidity. A pleasant breeze, feels nice.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗 24℃，北风 4级。风力稍大，出门可别忘了带外套。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Hangzhou at 24°C, north wind force 4. It's a bit windy, don't forget your jacket when you go out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗 24℃，体感舒适。风力 3级，湿度适中，是个好天气！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Nanjing at 24°C, feels comfortable. Moderate wind, suitable humidity, lovely weather!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云 24℃，体感 26℃。东南风轻柔，湿度稍高，很舒服。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Chengdu at 24°C, feels like 26°C. A gentle southeast breeze and slightly higher humidity make it pleasant.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗 25℃，体感 27℃，微热。西南风拂面，户外活动愉快。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Wuhan at 25°C, feels like 27°C, a bit warm. A southwest breeze, enjoy your outdoor activities.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗 23℃，体感舒适。北风微弱，户外散步的好时光。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Xi'an at 23°C, feels comfortable. A light north wind, perfect for a stroll outside.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云 24℃，体感 25℃。风力微弱，湿度 67%，感觉有点闷热。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Chongqing at 24°C, feels like 25°C. Very light wind, 67% humidity, feels a bit muggy.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 19℃ 晴朗，体感 17℃。风力 4级较凉，出门添衣哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Harbin at 19°C, feels like 17°C. A stronger wind, so layer up when you go out.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗 20℃，体感 19℃。北风 4级，风力稍大，注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Shenyang at 20°C, feels like 19°C. North wind force 4, a bit windy, remember to stay warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天 17℃，体感 15℃。北风 3级，有点凉，注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Kunming at 17°C, feels like 15°C. A north wind, it's a bit cool, remember to add a layer.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天 25℃，北风 5级，风力较大。出门注意防风，海边更要注意哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Xiamen at 25°C, north wind force 5, quite windy. Be mindful of the wind when you go out, especially by the sea!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗 24℃，体感 23℃。南风 4级，风力适中，户外游玩好时节。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Qingdao at 24°C, feels like 23°C. South wind force 4, moderate wind, a great time for outdoor activities.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗 22℃，体感 21℃。北风 4级，湿度低，注意补水保湿哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Dalian at 22°C, feels like 21°C. North wind force 4, low humidity, remember to hydrate and moisturize.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天 25℃，体感 26℃。东北风 4级，湿度 71%，记得带伞。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Zhangpu at 25°C, feels like 26°C. Northeast wind force 4, 71% humidity, remember to bring an umbrella.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴朗 24℃，风力 4级稍大，出门注意防风，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny at 24°C with a strong wind. Be mindful of the wind to avoid catching a cold!
